description: Update center: release evaluation, download and the install plan. Works before sign-in and with every IM node down; the release manifest comes from the access mirrors.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Current update state, download progress included. No network request of its own; readable before sign-in, when no event reaches the host. With foreground it first counts as a return to the foreground, once however often that is reported, so a controller does not depend on lifecycle.setAppState arriving first.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Starts a check of the release manifest and answers at once: the state is checking while the round runs in the background, so poll getState or follow update://state. A non-manual check is limited to once in six hours and otherwise answers the current state; a manual one is not, and a failure lands in error. A request during a running round joins it.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Downloads the package of a release of kind package and returns when it is done. Progress goes through update://state and getState. On a metered network without allowMetered, error is update.meteredConfirmationRequired.

methods.name: install
methods.description: The install plan for the platform package to run; the state moves to installing. Throws with an update.* code when there is nothing to install.

methods.name: reportInstall
methods.description: Reports what the platform package did with the plan.

methods.name: defer
methods.description: Later. While downloading or verifying it only puts the prompt away; otherwise it defers for 24 hours. A forced update answers update.notSkippable in error.

methods.name: skip
methods.description: Skips one optional version. A forced update answers update.notSkippable in error.

methods.name: markPrompted
methods.description: Tells the core a prompt really appeared; the frequency rules and the prompt held through an update flow count on it.

methods.name: setLocale
methods.description: Chooses the language of the release notes and blockReason, ahead of app.locale; applies at once and survives another init.

methods.name: getResources
methods.description: The verified resource packs of this run, sorted by id. Read once at process start and fixed until the process ends: packs downloaded or withdrawn meanwhile take effect on the next start. Works before sign-in and waits for the startup read.
